framework: Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript; Python build scripts
fonts: Local Geist, Newsreader, Sora and Archivo font assets are present. H uses the existing self-hosted Archivo variable font and its OFL license; no runtime font loader is used.
palette: Existing variants use design-specific CSS tokens. No project-wide design.md was found; H uses a separate Grid OKLCH token sheet with cool paper, ink and one ultramarine signal ink.
motion: No animation package is involved. Shared behavior is in v/app.js; it supports the click-to-play AB23 facade. Grid H uses hover-only diagram states and disables motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
spacing: Hallmark pages use variant-specific 4-point spacing scales. H follows the Grid 12-column layout and 120–160px desktop section rhythm.
mobile: Hallmark pages are explicitly checked at 320, 375, 414 and 768 CSS pixels.
data_contract: Preserve the shared tools/content.py strings, merchant dataset, photo credits, bilingual parity, and privacy-first AB23 facade.
design_system: No design.md present; existing designs A/C/D/AC/AD/CD are not being retrofitted. Hallmark H uses Map / Diagram, Grid, H9, N9 and Ft2; no scroll reveal because Grid forbids it.
